example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এতটা গরু যে সাধারণ কথাও বুঝতে পারে না।
এই গরু কাজটি করতে গিয়ে সব নষ্ট করে দিল।
example_sentences_in_english: He is such a cow that he can't even understand simple instructions.
This idiot ruined everything by acting like a complete fool.
note: The idiom uses the cow as a symbol of dullness, common in rural Bengali speech.
